excerpt_i18n.en:
On April 4th, Alibaba's new model Qwen3.6-Plus, released just one day prior, surged to the top of the daily rankings on the globally renowned large model API platform OpenRouter, becoming the most sought-after large model by enterprises and developers. Official data from OpenRouter shows that Qwen3.6-Plus's daily token calls exceeded 1.4 trillion, setting a new global record for single-day, single-model calls on the platform.  

OpenRouter is the world's largest AI large model API aggregation platform, hosting APIs from well-known domestic and international models such as Claude, GPT, Qwen, DeepSeek, and GLM. By tracking token consumption from developers and enterprises, OpenRouter generates a large model call volume ranking, widely regarded as a real-world battleground reflecting the actual market popularity of large models.  

On the morning of April 2nd, Alibaba released Qwen3.6-Plus, the strongest domestic programming model, achieving breakthroughs in programming and agent capabilities. In the programming sub-ranking of the internationally recognized large model arena Arena, the preview version of Qwen3.6-Plus ranked first in China.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 4 de abril, apenas un día después de su lanzamiento, el nuevo modelo Qwen3.6-Plus de Alibaba se posicionó en el primer lugar del ranking diario de OpenRouter, la reconocida plataforma global de APIs para modelos de gran escala, convirtiéndose en el modelo más solicitado por empresas y desarrolladores. Según datos oficiales de OpenRouter, las llamadas diarias a Qwen3.6-Plus superaron los 1.4 billones de tokens, estableciendo un récord mundial en el volumen de llamadas diarias para un solo modelo en la plataforma. items.title: MicroSafe-RL – Deterministic 1.18µs safety layer for Edge AI
items.raw_excerpt:
I built MicroSafe-RL to solve the "hardware destruction" problem during Reinforcement Learning and Edge LLM deployment. The Tech: It’s a bare-metal C++ interceptor using an EMA+MAD stability metric derived from Control Lyapunov Functions.
Performance: 1.18 microseconds worst-case execution time (WCET). No heap, no dynamic allocation, just 24 bytes of state.
The "Bridge": The latest update includes a Python-C++ bridge to use local LLMs (like Gemma 4 via Ollama) as robotic controllers while keeping them physically safe. Currently under review at IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems. GitHub: https://github.com/Kretski/MicroSafe-RL

title_i18n.en: MicroSafe-RL – Deterministic 1.18µs safety layer for Edge AI
title_i18n.zh: MicroSafe-RL——面向边缘AI的确定性1.18微秒安全层
title_i18n.es: MicroSafe-RL – Capa de seguridad determinista de 1,18 µs para IA en el Edge

excerpt_i18n.en:
I built MicroSafe-RL to solve the "hardware destruction" problem during Reinforcement Learning and Edge LLM deployment. The Tech: It’s a bare-metal C++ interceptor using an EMA+MAD stability metric derived from Control Lyapunov Functions.
Performance: 1.18 microseconds worst-case execution time (WCET). No heap, no dynamic allocation, just 24 bytes of state.
The "Bridge": The latest update includes a Python-C++ bridge to use local LLMs (like Gemma 4 via Ollama) as robotic controllers while keeping them physically safe. Currently under review at IEEE Transactions on Aerospace and Electronic Systems. GitHub: https://github.com/Kretski/MicroSafe-RL
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我开发MicroSafe-RL旨在解决强化学习与边缘大语言模型部署中的“硬件损毁”问题。其技术核心是采用基于控制理论EMA+MAD稳定性指标的裸机C++拦截器。
excerpt_i18n.es: Desarrollé MicroSafe-RL para resolver el problema de "destrucción de hardware" durante el Aprendizaje por Refuerzo y el despliegue de LLM en el Edge. La tecnología: es un interceptor en C++ de metal desnudo que utiliza una métrica de estabilidad EMA+MAD derivada del Control L.
